home.heroSummary: Premium performance and lifestyle sneakers — designed in Colombo, built for the street.
home.heroSlideDesc: Lightweight performance runner with responsive foam midsole and breathable engineered mesh — precision-built for daily miles and urban tempo.
home.heroSlideVelocityDesc: Race-day inspired speed trainer with a propulsive plate and featherweight upper — engineered for runners who chase personal bests.
home.heroSlideFluxDesc: Retro-inspired silhouette with modern comfort technology — archive design language refined for contemporary streetwear.
home.heroSlideMonoDesc: Minimal lifestyle sneaker with monochromatic design language — clean lines, premium leather, and versatile everyday presence.
home.newArrivalsDesc: The latest silhouettes from our design lab — limited runs, premium materials.
home.categoryDesc: From performance runners to street-ready classics — explore categories built for every movement.
home.editorialDesc: The VANTA Velocity combines race-day propulsion with everyday durability. A carbon-infused plate, featherweight upper, and precision-engineered outsole — designed for runners who refuse to compromise.
home.bestSellersDesc: Community favorites — the pairs our customers keep coming back for.
home.storyDesc: VANTA was born from a simple belief: footwear should perform as beautifully as it looks. Every silhouette is developed in our Colombo design lab — tested on streets, refined in studio, built for real life.
home.promoDesc: Selected styles from previous seasons. Limited sizes available.
